digest.overview: OpenAI slashed GPT-5.6 Luna prices 80% and Terra 20%, extending its price-performance lead. Google DeepMind released Gemini Robotics 2 for whole-body humanoid control and multi-robot tasks. Google also credited AI with fixing a record number of Chrome bugs in June.

top_story.headline: OpenAI cuts GPT-5.6 Luna price 80%, beats DeepSeek on perf/price
top_story.summary: OpenAI announced GPT-5.6 Luna at 80% lower cost and Terra at 20% lower, with graphs showing frontier gains over prior models and competitors.
top_story.why_it_matters: Directly advances the price-performance frontier on production models; HN thread hit 353 points with discussion of real-world implications.

sentiment.label: bullish
sentiment.summary: Community focused on rapid capability gains and cost drops in frontier models plus physical AI progress; excitement around robotics demos tempered by typical safety notes.

model_releases.headline: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Luna/Terra price cuts
model_releases.summary: Luna down 80%, Terra 20%; claims best price/performance vs DeepSeek and others.

model_releases.headline: Inkling-Small (276B total / 12B active, 1M context)
model_releases.summary: New small model release with NVFP4 and GGUF quants available.

frontier_labs.headline: Gemini Robotics 2 adds whole-body control and multi-robot collab
frontier_labs.summary: DeepMind model now handles full humanoid motion from feet to fingertips plus multi-agent orchestration; one variant public.

frontier_labs.headline: Google credits AI for record Chrome bug fixes
frontier_labs.summary: June patches exceeded prior 23 updates combined; AI tools drove exponential discovery.

research_radar.headline: Echoverse: evolving environments for computer-use agents
research_radar.summary: Microsoft Research trains agents in dynamic, realistic multi-step workflows that change over time.

research_radar.headline: EvoLib: turning experience into evolving knowledge
research_radar.summary: Microsoft approach extracts reusable skills from LLM experience for long-term adaptation.

post_ideas.hook: OpenAI just made frontier inference dramatically cheaper again
post_ideas.draft: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Luna at -80% price. The gap between closed frontier and everything else just widened on cost.
post_ideas.why_viral: Direct numbers on price/performance shift that affects every builder's economics right now.

post_ideas.hook: Gemini Robotics 2 now moves the whole robot body
post_ideas.draft: DeepMind's latest controls humanoids from feet to fingertips and coordinates multiple robots. Physical deployment just got one step closer.
post_ideas.why_viral: Visual robotics progress always drives strong engagement; clear step from upper-body only.

post_ideas.hook: LinkedIn now has an official 'AI slop' report button
post_ideas.draft: LinkedIn adding a dedicated 'seems like AI slop' flag while killing its own AI writing tool. Platform finally admitting the volume problem.
post_ideas.why_viral: Relatable frustration with low-quality AI content; meta move by the platform itself.
